ideas.children_he: ה׳ אוֹמֵר לָעָם לְהַמְשִׁיךְ אֶל הָאָרֶץ עִם מַלְאָךְ שֶׁיַּדְרִיךְ אוֹתָם. בִּגְלַל חֲטָאֵיהֶם הוּא לֹא יֵלֵךְ בְּתוֹכָם כְּמוֹ קֹדֶם.
ideas.children_en: God commands Moses and the people to continue toward the Promised Land, promising to send an angel before them and drive out the Canaanite nations. Yet because of their stubbornness, He will not go among them. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: הָעָם עָצוּב לִשְׁמֹעַ שֶׁה׳ לֹא יֵלֵךְ אִתּוֹ. הָאֲנָשִׁים מוֹרִידִים אֶת הַתַּכְשִׁיטִים כְּסִימָן לְצַעַר וְלַחֲרָטָה.
ideas.children_en: The people hear the troubling message, mourn, and remove their jewelry and ornaments as a sign of grief, humility, and waiting for God’s decision. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: מֹשֶׁה מַקִּים אוֹהֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה. עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן יוֹרֵד לַפֶּתַח, וְה׳ מְדַבֵּר עִמּוֹ יְשִׁירוֹת, כְּמוֹ אָדָם עִם חָבֵר. יְהוֹשֻׁעַ שׁוֹמֵר בָּאוֹהֶל.
ideas.children_en: Moses sets up the Tent of Meeting outside the camp. The people watch, the pillar of cloud descends at its entrance, and God speaks with Moses face to face; Joshua remains serving in the tent. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: מֹשֶׁה מְבַקֵּשׁ שֶׁה׳ עַצְמוֹ יֵלֵךְ עִם הָעָם וִילַמֵּד אוֹתוֹ אֶת דַּרְכּוֹ. ה׳ מַסְכִּים כִּי מֹשֶׁה יָקָר לוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Moses asks to know who will accompany the people and to understand God’s ways. He emphasizes the people’s need for God’s presence, and God promises that His presence will go with them because Moses has found favor. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: מֹשֶׁה מְבַקֵּשׁ לִרְאוֹת אֶת כְּבוֹד ה׳. ה׳ מַסְבִּיר שֶׁאָדָם אֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לִרְאוֹת אוֹתוֹ בִּשְׁלֵמוּת וְלִחְיוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Moses asks to see God’s glory. God promises to let His goodness pass before him and reveal His compassion, but explains that no human can see His face and live. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: ה׳ שׁוֹמֵר עַל מֹשֶׁה בְּפֶתַח בַּסֶּלַע וּמַרְאֶה לוֹ רַק מְעַט מִכְּבוֹדוֹ. הַתֵּאוּר מַדְגִּישׁ שֶׁהָאָדָם אֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לִרְאוֹת הַכֹּל.
ideas.children_en: God places Moses in a cleft of the rock and covers him with His hand as His glory passes by. Afterwards Moses sees only the passing glory from behind, not God’s face. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.
